description: Partial collection with documented corrections and source-specific research evidence. Counts are calculated from authoritative academic records; archives, aliases and evidence rows are excluded.
scopeNote: 15 institutions are in scope (Saegis excluded); 15 have collected profiles. An institution or unit without collected profiles is not an institution without academic staff, and collected profiles are not the total academic population.
limitations: Not an exhaustive national census: collected profiles are a subset of the academic population, and directory coverage is incomplete for every institution.
Name variants and cross-institution appointments may be duplicated; unresolved identity cases are reviewed privately.
Google Scholar, ResearchGate and OpenAlex report different counts. Values from different providers are not interchangeable.
Qualification and teaching evidence can be incomplete. A title such as Dr, a recorded doctoral institution or ambiguous text is not evidence of a completed PhD.
Country identifies the awarding institution, not necessarily the physical location of study.
